messages:
Nina: Hey Austin folks  VP visiting Thursday, need a casual brunch spot near Rainey/6th. Group of 5, at least 2 gluten-free and 1 vegan. Prefer walkable from the office, shaded outdoor seating if possible. Any go-tos?

Ben: Tacodeli is easy and has GF tortillas and good breakfast tacos. Not a huge patio but quick. :taco:

Raj: Bouldin Creek Cafe is the OG for vegans/vegetarians  huge menu, solid outdoor seating, will please the vegan. Highly recommend for groups.

Emily: Odd Duck is lovely for brunch and they can do shared plates; not strictly GF but theyre good about swaps. Takes a reservation for larger groups.

Oscar: If the VP wants something more impressive but still relaxed, Emmer & Rye does seasonal small plates and has a covered patio. Might be pricier.

Nina: Thanks! Budget mid-range. Would prefer somewhere that can do a quick table for 5 without crazy wait.

Ben: Tacodeli or Bouldin then. Tacodeli faster, Bouldin more chill and vegan-friendly.

Raj: Quick poll? lunchbot, can you run a short reaction poll: Tacodeli / Bouldin Creek / Emmer & Rye?

lunchbot: Poll created by Raj  React to vote: Tacodeli / Bouldin Creek / Emmer & Rye

Emily: Bouldin Creek for me  easier for gluten-free+vegan combo.

Oscar: Tacodeli if timing is tight.

Ben: Tacodeli  I can grab tacos-to-go and we can sit at the park if it's busy.

Nina: Voting Bouldin Creek. If it wins Ill call ahead to check seating and GF options.

lunchbot: Poll results  Tacodeli: 2 votes, Bouldin Creek: 2 votes, Emmer & Rye: 1 vote.

Nina: Tie! Okay quick tie-breaker - who can call and reserve? Prefer someone local who can confirm shaded outdoor seating.

Ben: I can call Tacodeli to check wait times at 10:30.

Raj: Ill call Bouldin Creek and ask about vegan brunch platters + outdoor table.

Emily: If both are weird, fallback is Jeffersons for a reliable group brunch.

Nina: Awesome, appreciate it. Will pick based on who gets a quicker confirmation and DM details. Thanks team! :seedling:
